item.title: EOI - Journal’s Administrator & Briefs and Working papers series - ECMR
item.description: The Macroeconomics Policy, Forecasting and Research Department of the African Development Bank The Department (ECMR) is in charge of producing a number of knowledge products, including flagship reports, research papers and economic briefs. To support the team of researchers and the work process for publication of the Journal, the Bank is seeking to recruit a consultant to work as a Research Assistant.
item.dc:creator: African Development Bank

item.title: EOI - Operations Management Specialist to support the delivery of the Nigeria Country Department’s Work Programme - RDNG
item.description: Operations Management Specialist will effectively assist the Task Managers and Executing Agencies/Project Implementing Units of the Bank-Financed Operations in Nigeria improve compliance with best practice in project management, as well as loan covenants, Environmental & Social Safeguards, and audit requirements.
